title: Retrospective Rolling NSE Research Protocol (LightGBM + NSGA-II)
nature: Retrospective (earlier single-split results have been inspected; results remain exploratory historical evidence)
research_question: Does a hybrid predictive classifier (LightGBM) combined with multi-objective evolutionary strategy optimization (NSGA-II) discover trading policies that offer a superior or useful risk/return trade-off across Indian equities and temporal market regimes compared to standard benchmarks and ablations?
portfolio_presentation: Assets evaluated strictly individually; no portfolio blending or cross-asset diversification is claimed.

fold_window_structure.description: Each annual fold shifts forward by 1 year. E.g. Test 2020 uses Train 2012-2016, Val 2017, Dev 2018-2019, Test 2020.

purging_and_isolation.warmup_policy: Technical indicators computed over available historical prefix; initial 200 bars dropped for indicator stabilization.
purging_and_isolation.purge_policy: At chronological boundaries (Train -> Val, Val -> Dev, Dev -> Test), trailing 3 bars whose forward targets overlap subsequent partitions are purged from supervised datasets.
purging_and_isolation.test_isolation: Test partition prices, indicators, predictions, and returns are strictly unavailable during model fitting, early stopping, NSGA-II evolution, and representative strategy selection. Test labels are used exclusively for post-hoc evaluation.

objectives: Maximize Sharpe Ratio (with GA inactivity penalty if trades < 5)
Minimize Maximum Drawdown (with GA inactivity penalty if trades < 5)
evolutionary_specification.selection_rule: Highest Development Sharpe among strategies with Dev trades >= 5. If none meet >= 5 trades, hold cash (100% cash, 0 trades) and record infeasibility.

benchmarks_and_ablations.buy_and_hold: Full exposure entering at first test bar Open with commission and slippage, liquidating at final test bar Close.
benchmarks_and_ablations.cash_baseline: 100% cash allocation earning 0.0% nominal return (risk-free rate = 0).
benchmarks_and_ablations.sma_50_200: Long when Close[t-1] > SMA50[t-1] and SMA50[t-1] > SMA200[t-1]; cash otherwise. Enters/exits at Open with standard friction.
benchmarks_and_ablations.fixed_gene_hybrid: LightGBM model with fixed unoptimized chromosome [0.55, 0.45, 2.0, 3.5, 0.03, 0.5, 15.0].
benchmarks_and_ablations.constant_prob_ablation: NSGA-II strategy evolved without ML by substituting constant p_up = 0.60 across Dev and Test.
benchmarks_and_ablations.exposure_matched_bh: Diagnostic blending Buy & Hold daily returns with cash using the hybrid strategy's DEVELOPMENT exposure fraction.
